pages.title: The Heart
pages.text: Your Heart equips itself in its own curio slot. It cannot be crafted or removed. Alignment belongs to you, not the item: black at −50, grey at 0 and white at +50. World difficulty determines which deeds count.

pages.title: Two switches
pages.text: Both the common setting [conscience] enabled and the world rule doConscienceHeart must be on. Both default to on. Turning the Heart off does not erase merchant favor.

pages.title: All difficulties
pages.text: Each game day, animal kills cost 1 point each starting with your 31st. Killing a villager or iron golem costs 5. If no player gets the kill, nearby players within 5 blocks lose the points instead.

pages.title: Defending villagers
pages.text: Every 20 raiders or vexes defeated earn 1 point; every 100 undead earn 1. Gaining Hero of the Village earns 5, but refreshing it does not. Peaceful and Easy use these base rules.

pages.title: Normal adds
pages.text: All base rules still apply. Breaking village structure blocks costs 1 each; opening an untouched village loot chest costs 3. A nearby villager gaining a job earns 1; losing a job costs 1.

pages.title: Hard adds
pages.text: Normal rules still apply. Every 50 untouched loot chests opened cost 1. Lose 1 if your servant dies while you are alive in the same dimension.

pages.title: Hard: housing
pages.text: Place a bed for a homeless villager for +1; each nearby villager with reputation 30 or higher earns +1 per game day.

pages.title: Combat effects
pages.text: Each good point lowers ordinary damage taken and attack damage dealt by 1% and raises max health by 1%. Evil reverses this. Each scales separately. Against $(l:momo_battle)Boss Momo$(), her special reduction replaces the Heart's usual incoming multiplier.

pages.title: Good thresholds
pages.text: +20: Regeneration II. +30: +50% Luck. +40: +1 Fortune. +45: villagers charge 10% of normal prices. +50: mobs do not initiate attacks but can retaliate; survive a lethal hit once per 200 seconds.

pages.title: Evil thresholds
pages.text: −20: the Life Lamp Ring cannot lift the Seven Curses. −30: −50% Luck. −40: Fortune falls to zero. −45: villager prices rise 90%; a 40% chance of Unnamable every 200 seconds. −50: mobs turn hostile.
